description: This Java class 'ImageResizer' provides functionality to resize images while maintaining aspect ratio. It reads image data, rescales images if they exceed specified maximum dimensions, and outputs resized images. The class uses Java AWT and ImageIO libraries for image processing and logs operations via SLF4J.

classes.name: ImageResizer
classes.description: A service class responsible for resizing image files while maintaining aspect ratio, using Java AWT for image processing.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the provided FileData object if it exceeds the specified maximum width or height; returns the original if resizing isn't needed or fails.

methods.name: resizeImage
methods.description: Performs the actual image resizing based on computed scale ratio, returning an InputStream of the resized image.
